# pipoke

> Utils to acquire stuff from pypi and interrogate it


## Pages in this subsection

- [pipoke](pipoke.html.md): | &#96;words_and_pkg_names_satisfying_condition&#96;(cond)                                             |    ...
- [pipoke.distribution](pipoke.distribution.html.md): Tools to run on PyPi distribution of packages.
- [pipoke.misc](pipoke.misc.html.md): Miscellaneous helpers for relating python objects to modules and package names.
- [pipoke.pkg_diagnosis](pipoke.pkg_diagnosis.html.md): Pip installed package diagnosis
- [pipoke.pkg_vs_words](pipoke.pkg_vs_words.html.md): Compare package names with words (e.g. which package names are also dictionary words).
- [pipoke.pypi_store](pipoke.pypi_store.html.md): A mapping view to pypi projects
- [pipoke.word_conditions](pipoke.word_conditions.html.md): Small predicates on words, used to characterize package names.
